name: unbounded_lp
description: LP expressed as one diagonal (block_size = -2) cone block: max x_1 s.t. x_2 = 1, x >= 0. Primal UNBOUNDED (objective +infinity): only x_2 is pinned, x_1 >= 0 grows freely. Exercises the LP/diagonal cone path of the (tau,kappa) infeasibility detector. Maps to the dual_infeasible status class (expected_solve_status('unbounded') -> DUAL_INFEASIBLE).
witness: Recession ray xhat = (1,0): A_1 . xhat = 0 (A_1 pins x_2), c . xhat = 1 > 0, xhat >= 0. An unbounded improving direction certifying primal unboundedness (= dual infeasibility).
